# Astera Loader plugin header

Astera Loader repository (`include/al/al_plugin.h`), release tag `v0.1.0`,
commit `ba04bd1eb19dd067651c7866d6a85d1c77dc477e`. Byte for byte the file in
`AsteraLoader-plugin-kit-0.1.0.zip` (SHA-256

endings). MIT licence (`LICENSE`, Astera Loader project).

Update by copying the newer header and recording the tag and commit here.
